a: They cancel each other's magnetism completely.

questions.q: Which of the following metals is classified as non-magnetic?
a: Wood or plastic (or non-magnetic metals like zinc/brass)

Curves looping from the North pole to the South pole

a: It decreases as the field lines spread further apart.

questions.q: Which of these is a major advantage of an electromagnet over a permanent magnet?
a: It requires no energy source ever.
It can be switched on and off and its strength can be adjusted.
It works only in outer space.

questions.q: What is magnetic induction?
a: The heating of a wire by electric current
The evaporation of liquid from a surface
The process where a piece of unmagnetized magnetic material becomes magnetized when placed near a magnetic field
The creation of gravity by spinning masses

questions.q: Which tool uses a small magnetized needle balanced on a pivot to help hikers find direction?
What happens when a current-carrying wire is wrapped around an iron nail?
a: It stops the electric current completely.

questions.q: Which of the following describes the Earth's geographic North Pole relative to magnetism?
a: It is actually near a magnetic South pole attracting the North-seeking pole of a compass.
It is a pure magnetic North pole repelling all compasses.

questions.q: How does reversing the direction of the electric current flowing through an electromagnet affect its poles?
a: The positions of the North and South poles reverse.

a: The number of turns in the coil
The size of the electric current

a: Its internal magnetic domains point in random directions, canceling each other out.

questions.q: What happens to iron filings when placed near the center (side) of a bar magnet compared to the poles?

By being strongly heated or repeatedly dropped and hammered

Opening the switch to cut off the electric current

questions.q: What are the regions of a magnet where the magnetic force is strongest called?

questions.q: What happens when you sprinkle iron filings over a wire carrying a large direct electric current?
a: They form straight lines parallel to the wire.
They gather in a single ball.
They form concentric circles centered around the wire.
